name: Can I troubleshoot minor commercial water heater issues myself?

mainEntity.name: Can I troubleshoot minor commercial water heater issues myself?

acceptedAnswer.text: Some minor commercial water heater issues can be safely troubleshooted, such as checking for tripped breakers or pilot light outages if you have a gas unit. However, for most internal component issues, leaks, or complex electrical problems, it's recommended to call a professional. Attempting repairs without proper training or tools can exacerbate the problem or pose safety risks. CG Plumbing Solutions advises contacting a qualified technician to ensure safe and effective resolution.
acceptedAnswer.description: You can troubleshoot simple issues like tripped breakers, but for complex or internal problems, professional help is recommended to avoid safety risks.
